fact: On 12 February 2026 the Head of the Civil Service honoured 35 officers from seven MDAs at the Digital Literacy for All programme awards, describing a programme designed to equip officers across MDAs with foundational digital skills.
title: FG Advances Digital Transformation as HCSF Presents NITDA-Donated Laptops to 35 Civil Servants at DL4ALL Awards
publisher: Office of the Head of the Civil Service of the Federation
